desc: Mossberg 817 combines the sleek style and feel of the 802 Plinkster bolt action with the immensely popular .17HMR caliber. This model is ideal for the serious varmint hunting crowd as it for the casual shooter trying out his or her aim on long distance targets. It features sizzling, long range performance and factory installed Weaver style scope bases for quick and easy scope attachment. This model features a synthetic stock with a stippled grip and forend, dual swivel studs, and a thick vented recoil pad.
